text: Aaron Charles Carter (December 7, 1987 – November 5, 2022) was an American singer and rapper who gained fame as a teen pop artist in the late 1990s and became a prominent figure among preteen and teenage audiences during the early 2000s through his four studio albums. He began performing at age seven, following the formation of his brother Nick's group, the Backstreet Boys, and released his self-titled debut album in 1997 at age nine, which sold one million copies worldwide. His second album, *Aaron's Party (Come Get It)*, released in the United States on September 26, 2000, sold over three million copies and was certified 3× platinum by the RIAA; it included hit singles like "I Want Candy," "Aaron's Party (Come Get It)," "That's How I Beat Shaq," and "Bounce," all of which received airplay on Disney Channel and Nickelodeon. Carter made guest appearances on Nickelodeon and toured with the Backstreet Boys after the album's release. His third studio album, *Oh Aaron*, released on August 7, 2001, went platinum and featured a duet with his brother Nick and a song with the group No Secrets; it also included tracks used in the *Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius* soundtrack. His fourth studio album, *Another Earthquake!*, was released on September 3, 2002, and included the patriotic song "America A.O." and the ballad "Do You Remember." He guest-starred on three episodes of *All That* and sang the theme song to the PBS series *Liberty's Kids*. In 2002, Carter's parents filed a lawsuit against his former manager Lou Pearlman over unpaid royalties from his 1998 album, which was released through Pearlman's label Trans Continental; Pearlman was declared in contempt of court for ignoring a court order to produce documents, though the suit was settled out of court. His *Most Requested Hits* collection, released on November 3, 2003, included tracks from his previous albums and a new single, "One Better." In 2005, he released "Saturday Night," promoted that summer, and featured in the film *Popstar*, which was based on his life; he also appeared in *Supercross*. On March 21, 2006, Trans Continental filed a lawsuit against Carter, citing a breach of a recording deal signed when he was 17; Carter's attorney argued he had the right to cancel or void agreements made as a minor. Carter and his siblings starred in the reality show *House of Carters*, which aired from October to November 2006 on E!. In 2009, he joined season 9 of *Dancing with the Stars*, finishing in fifth place with partner Karina Smirnoff, and released online singles such as "Dance with Me" featuring Flo Rida. In January 2011, his manager Johnny Wright announced Carter entered a treatment facility for emotional and spiritual issues; he later completed a month of rehab at the Betty Ford Center in Rancho Mirage, California. In November 2011, he began starring in the off-Broadway musical *The Fantasticks* at the Snapple Theater Center in New York City as the character Matt. In January 2012, he participated in *Rachael vs. Guy: Celebrity Cook-Off*, being eliminated in the first episode. In 2013, he launched his first tour in eight years, the *After Party Tour*, which ran from February to December 2013 and included over 150 shows in the United States and Canada. In June 2014, he performed on an 11-city Canadian tour and announced the *Wonderful World Tour*, named after a song from his upcoming album, which included 50 dates and ran from September 2014 to January 2015. In July 2014, he performed "Ooh Wee" featuring Pat SoLo on *Good Day L.A.* In February 2015, he released an EP titled *The Music Never Stopped* on SoundCloud. In January 2016, he released a music video for "Curious" under the name Kid Carter, co-directed by Michael D. Monroe, Ben Epstein, and himself. In April 2016, he released the single "Fool's Gold," and in January 2017, released "Sooner or Later." Both songs appeared on the EP *LØVË*, released in February 2017, written by Carter, Jon Asher, Melanie Fontana, Taylor "Lakestreet Louie" Helgeson, and Michel Schulz, and produced and independently released by Carter through his label Rakkaus Records. His fifth studio album, also titled *Love*, was released on February 16, 2018. Two days after his death on November 5, 2022, the album *Blacklisted* was released on all music platforms as a tribute to Carter, originally scheduled for December 7, his 35th birthday, but the release was criticized by his management, who had not authorized it; the album was deleted during late November and is now unavailable, though some songs were later re-released on an EP titled *The Prince of Pop* by his collaborator 3D Friends. On April 5, 2024, a new posthumous release titled *Recovery* was announced and released on May 24. As a teenager, Carter dated several high-profile celebrities, including Hilary Duff and Lindsay Lohan. On September 17, 2006, at age 18, he became engaged to Kari Ann Peniche, proposing on stage at the Palms Casino Resort in Las Vegas, but broke off the engagement after six days, calling it impulsive. He began dating Madison Parker in 2016, breaking up in August 2017. In August 2017, Carter came out as bisexual through Twitter and made a guest appearance on the podcast *LGBTQ&A* to discuss his career and sexuality, reaffirming his bisexuality publicly, though he stated all his past relationships were with women. He had a son born on November 22, 2021, with then-fiancée Melanie Martin. On November 7, 2013, Carter filed for bankruptcy to settle over $3.5 million in debt, mostly back taxes from income earned when he was a minor, with the IRS owing him $1.3 million from 2003 income; he settled all tax debt in 2014. In March 2020, he set up an OnlyFans account, charging $50 to $100 per nude photo or $26 a month, with reviews describing the content as bizarre and negative. In September 2017, he appeared on *The Doctors* to discuss his gaunt appearance and drug-related arrests; tests revealed he had a candida infection and tested positive for a mixture of benzodiazepines with opioids, which he said he used for anxiety and sleep, though he tested negative for illegal drugs. He was malnourished at 115 pounds (52 kg) and was advised to enter rehab; he later admitted to Alo House in Malibu, California, and reported improvement by February 2018, with a weight of 160 pounds (73 kg). In 2019, he and his mother appeared on *Marriage Bootcamp: Family Edition*. In a 2019 appearance on *The Doctors*, he disclosed he had been diagnosed with both schizophrenia and bipolar disorder. In February 2008, he was arrested in Kimble County, Texas, for speeding with just under two ounces of marijuana found in his car. In July 2017, he was arrested in Georgia on suspicion of driving under the influence and marijuana charges; he pleaded no contest to reckless driving, was placed on probation, and was ordered to perform community service and pay $1,500 in court fees and fines. In August 2019, he was granted a restraining order against Russian model Lina Valentina after she threatened to stab him. In March 2020, his girlfriend Melanie Martin was arrested in Los Angeles following an alleged domestic violence incident. In January 2020, German artist Jonas Jödicke tweeted that Carter was using his copyrighted artwork to promote merchandise; Carter responded that Jödicke "should've taken it as a compliment," and later agreed to pay Jödicke $12,500 in June 2021. In August 2021, Carter was announced as a performer in the Las Vegas production of *Naked Boys Singing!*, but was let go before the show's debut for refusing to be vaccinated against COVID-19. On November 5, 2022, Carter died at his home in Lancaster, California, at age 34. His body was found in his bathtub by a housekeeper; he was cremated, and his ashes were left in the care of his twin sister Angel. The cause of death was not immediately publicized.

In January 2020, German artist Jonas Jödicke tweeted that Carter was using his copyrighted artwork without permission to promote merchandise. Carter responded on Twitter by saying Jödicke "should've taken it as a compliment." After the incident, Jödicke was interviewed by Forbes, stating he was "absolutely amazed" by Carter's reaction. In June 2021, Carter agreed to pay Jödicke $12,500. In August 2021, Carter was announced as a performer in the Las Vegas production of Naked Boys Singing!, but he was let go before the show's debut because he refused to be vaccinated for COVID-19. On November 5, 2022, Carter died at his home in Lancaster, California, at age 34. His body was found in his bathtub by a housekeeper. He was cremated, and his ashes were left in the care of his twin sister Angel. The cause of death was not immediately publicized, but the Los Angeles County Medical Examiner-Coroner later ruled that Carter's death was accidental drowning after inhaling difluoroethane and taking alprazolam (Xanax). Carter's ashes were interred at Forest Lawn Memorial Park.
